_notes: Universal card-extraction template. Every card (credit, debit, prepaid; any issuer) fills this same shape. Use null for 'not yet verified / unknown', use the string "N/A" for 'this field genuinely does not apply to this card' (e.g. cash_advance on a debit card, invite_only fields on an open-application card), and use [] for 'verified — this card has none of these'. Never delete a key because it doesn't apply — mark it N/A so downstream ingestion can tell 'not applicable' apart from 'not scraped yet'.

open_questions: Reward documents are older than the 2026 MITC and disagree in form: the Dec 2023 features sheet says "1 point valued at Re.1 for every Rs.100 spent" (Platinum, Select, Visa Gold) while the Jan 2025 poster says "cashback of Rs 1 for every Rs 100 spent, credited to the card statement in the same billing month" and Rs 0.50 per Rs 100 on rent, utilities, fuel, insurance, jewellery and government spends. Both give Rs 1 per Rs 100. The poster does not say which variants it covers (it shows Platinum cards). The 2026 MITC does not mention rewards. A person should confirm which variants earn the cashback and whether it is still current.
Poster note: no cashback on wallet load, EMI transactions, ATM withdrawals and UPI transactions below Rs 2,000. Whether there is a monthly cap is not stated.

Fuel: the MITC states a surcharge of Rs 10 or 2.5% of the transaction amount, whichever is higher, on petrol and pump purchases, and no surcharge waiver for these cards. Surcharge is recorded as 2.5% with the Rs 10 minimum noted here.

Cash advance: MITC states a fee of Rs 50 per cash advance and interest of 2.25% a month from the transaction date; the percentage-based fee is not applicable (flat Rs 50). Late fee Rs 250 flat (MITC).
Over limit fee Rs 50 flat (MITC schedule). EMI processing fee 2% of the converted amount, minimum Rs 199, maximum Rs 1,000; EMI interest 18% a year; foreclosure 3% of pending principal (MITC).
MITC states "All the charges and interest mentioned are excluding GST" only in the Youth MITC; the main MITC does not say it, so the GST flag follows the Youth MITC wording.
Lounge: the features sheet says "Airport Lounge Access: Yes" with no number of visits or lounge list; no quota recorded.
